financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Shares sold under the Sales Agreement (ATM)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On February 5, 2024, the Company sold shares under the Sales Agreement, resulting in net proceeds of $9.9 million.
On February 9, 2024, the Company sold shares in the Follow-on Offering, resulting in net proceeds of $76.9 million after deducting underwriters' fees of $3.2 million.
